title: Inventory Tracker (crud-heavy)
prompt:
# PRD — Inventory Tracker (crud-heavy)
PRD Standard: 1
Interface language: en-US

## 1. Problem and objective / Problema e objetivo

A signed-in team member needs to maintain stock quantities and find low-stock items without losing adjustment history.

## 2. Users and roles / Usuários e papéis

- Team member: manages inventory records owned by their account.

## 3. Scope and non-goals / Escopo e não objetivos

Categories, items, single and bulk quantity adjustments, history, and low-stock filtering are in scope. Multi-warehouse tracking, barcode scanning, suppliers, purchasing, files, exports, and analytics are excluded.

## 4. Primary journeys / Jornadas principais

1. A member signs in, creates a category and item, adjusts quantity with a reason, and finds the item through the low-stock filter.
2. A member selects multiple items and applies one reasoned quantity adjustment to each.

## 5. Screens and states / Telas e estados

The protected inventory shell contains category, item list, item form, bulk adjustment, and item history screens with loading, empty, error, forbidden, and success states.

## 6. Functional requirements / Requisitos funcionais

- **FR-001**: A member can create, edit, and delete categories, except a category containing items cannot be deleted.
- **FR-002**: A member can create, edit, delete, filter, and inspect items.
- **FR-003**: Single and bulk quantity changes require a reason and append one history entry per item.

## 7. Conceptual data and ownership / Dados conceituais e propriedade

Categories group items; each item has a unique SKU, quantity, and reorder threshold; each adjustment belongs to one item and records delta, reason, actor, and time. All records belong to the authenticated owner.

## 8. Business rules / Regras de negócio

- **BR-001**: Item quantity and reorder threshold are non-negative integers.
- **BR-002**: An item is low stock when quantity is less than or equal to its reorder threshold.

## 9. Authentication and permissions / Autenticação e permissões

All inventory routes require email/password authentication; owners may access only their records and cross-user access is denied.

## 10. Non-functional requirements / Requisitos não funcionais

- **NFR-001**: Forms and bulk actions are keyboard accessible and expose inline validation errors.

## 11. Acceptance criteria / Critérios de aceite

- **AC-001** — Verifies: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, BR-001, BR-002, NFR-001
  - Given an authenticated member with two items
  - When the member applies a reasoned bulk decrement that takes both items below threshold
  - Then both items appear in the low-stock filter and each history shows one new adjustment.

## 12. Assumptions / Premissas

None

## 13. Open decisions / Decisões em aberto

None
expectedCapabilities: A signed-in member creates categories and items, adjusts quantities, and filters low-stock items.
Bulk editing two or more items writes one reasoned adjustment per item.
Signed-out and cross-user inventory access is denied.
